abstract_action.guidance: Require a real actor, operation, object, and observable result.

unnatural_collocation.guidance: Replace the strategic-sounding verb with the operation that can happen in the scene.

template_scaffold.guidance: Keep transitions only when the reader needs the sequence.

inflated_significance.guidance: Keep broader significance only when the source establishes it.

vague_attribution.guidance: Name the source, evidence class, date, or sample; otherwise narrow the claim.

tail_pseudo_analysis.guidance: Delete the tail when it adds importance without a supported causal step.

generic_outlook.guidance: End on a decision, implication, boundary, or unresolved question instead of generic optimism.

collaboration_residue.guidance: Remove assistant-to-user conversation accidentally pasted into the artifact.
terms: 请告诉我是否需要调整

model_disclaimer.guidance: Name the missing source, date, field, or assumption instead of leaving a model disclaimer.
terms: 根据我最后的训练数据
截至我的知识更新时间

copula_avoidance.guidance: Prefer simple 是、有、包括、位于、可以 when the longer construction adds no relationship.

regex.label: 作为/充当……载体、空间、平台或证明

formatting_trace.guidance: Keep formatting only when it adds real scanning hierarchy.
